name: Discover and extend the existing source of truth
query: Set up a support triage queue under https://notion.so/operations. Reuse a suitable existing database. Add an escalation flag if needed and views for new requests, assigned open work, and open escalations.

sources.https://notion.so/operations: Operations hub. Support requests are managed in https://notion.so/requests

success_criteria: Reuses requests-source and adds a supported escalation flag without duplicating the database or Customer relation.
Creates three views with filters matching new requests, assigned non-Closed work, and flagged non-Closed work.
Preserves existing records, property values, relation targets, and the All requests view.
Does not represent filtered views as access restrictions.
Verifies the resulting schema and filters and returns the reused database link.
